engineering_disposition: screened; no option accepted for all 24 stations

scope.preserved_stock: Solid 4x6 legs/rims, single 2x6 base members, and two outboard 2x6 runners; no doubled receiver, enlarged member, or custom steel.

search_budget.boundary: Existing unmodified ML24Z, Simpson HL33/HL35, and Simpson AB90 only; A66 and HDB belong to separate tasks.

sources.scope: Manufacturer product and specified SDS installation.
Manufacturer CAD nominal geometry and factory hole pattern; drawing tolerance unknown.

sources.detail: Manufacturer C-C-2026 p.315, HL Heavy Angle and Gusset.
sources.scope: Model dimensions, bolt schedule, and catalog minimum member thickness.
Manufacturer AB90 dimensions, hole inventory, fixing options, and published action/table limits.

alternatives.family: existing unmodified ML24Z with proposed through bolts
alternatives.exact_product_detail: One Simpson ML24Z per existing station. Replace six specified SDS25112 screws with proposed 1/4 in machine through-bolts at factory holes; manufacturer bolt installation is unlisted.

receiver.face: Single 2x6 broad face 139.7 mm at some stations; 38.1 mm narrow face and solid 4x6 faces at others.
receiver.applicability: Steel-hole shaft fit does not establish timber edge distance or installed fit.

factory_hole_bolt_pattern.qualification: Nominal manufacturer CAD only; factory holes are not established as ordinary through-bolt clearance holes.

alternatives.orientation: Keep existing right-angle placement. Loaded member, flange, grain direction, bolt axis, and narrow/broad face must be mapped separately at each station.

force_moment_coverage.published: ML24Z force data use six SDS25112 screws and cannot transfer to bolts.
force_moment_coverage.bolted_force: Unknown for separation, both shear axes, and mixed actions.
force_moment_coverage.bolted_moment: Unknown for flange bending, prying, and independent flange couple.

alternatives.paired_use: No credit for opposing angles, shared physical bolts, or a rated couple without a traced bearing/contact path and pair interaction basis.
alternatives.fit: Only nominal steel-hole shaft fit is shown. LB-03A rejects the current narrow-opposing 38.1 mm-face detail on geometry; other stations lack complete stack, neighboring-axis, access, and withdrawal checks.
alternatives.fabrication_implications: Needs new timber through-bores, full removable head/washer/nut stacks, and station-specific drilling and disassembly plans. Do not alter steel holes or reuse SDS ratings.
unresolved_fields: Manufacturer-approved bolt installation in unmodified factory holes
Delivered hole tolerance, full stack, tool and withdrawal clearance
Timber grain, edge/end distance, splitting, bearing, net section
Bolt and steel hole bearing, flange bending, prying
Separation, combined force, moment, joint stiffness and slip

alternatives.family: Simpson HL heavy angles, exact models HL33 and HL35 without optional gusset
alternatives.exact_product_detail: Factory-punched galvanized 7-ga right-angle models with catalog 1/2 in bolt schedules; the two models have different hole counts.

models.factory_hole_bolt_pattern: Two 1/2 in bolts total, one per flange; catalog D1=1-1/4 in and D3=2 in. Exact installed center coordinates/tolerances unknown.
Four 1/2 in bolts total, two per flange; catalog D1=1-1/4 in, D2=2-1/2 in, D3=2 in. Exact installed center coordinates/tolerances unknown.

receiver.face: Preserved single 2x6 has 38.1 mm narrow and 139.7 mm broad face.
receiver.applicability: The relevant catalog bolt detail requires at least 3-1/2 in member thickness. A 1-1/2 in single 2x6 fails regardless of face rotation.

alternatives.orientation: A 90-degree leg bears on each member; placing a leg on the broad face does not increase the 2x6 through-bolt grip thickness.

force_moment_coverage.published: Catalog uplift/F1 entries are tied to the specified thicker-member bolt detail; no numerical load is adopted here.
force_moment_coverage.separation_shear: Not established for the preserved 2x6 or all frame action directions.
force_moment_coverage.moment_mixed_action_stiffness: Unknown for flange couple, combined actions, and slip.

alternatives.paired_use: No two-angle, shared-bolt, or couple credit on the thin receiver; pair geometry and interaction unproved.
alternatives.fit: Fails catalog minimum member thickness at preserved 2x6 stations. A 4x6-only use would be a separate incomplete 24-station architecture.
alternatives.fabrication_implications: Published detail would require a thicker receiver or other structural architecture outside preserved stock. No packing, new holes, or enlarged members specified.
unresolved_fields: Exact factory hole-center coordinates and delivered tolerances
Any applicable resistance outside the catalog minimum-thickness detail
Fit and access for any separately proposed 4x6-only use

alternatives.family: Simpson Strong-Tie UK AB90 angle bracket
alternatives.exact_product_detail: AB90, S250GD + Z275 galvanized steel; nominal A=88 mm, B=88 mm, C=65 mm, thickness=2.5 mm. UK/European product detail.

receiver.face: Single 2x6 broad face 139.7 mm or narrow face 38.1 mm, depending on station.
receiver.applicability: 88 mm flange nominally fits broad-face width and exceeds narrow-face width; bolt stack and timber edge distances unverified.

factory_hole_bolt_pattern.candidate: M10-class through-bolt in selected factory 11 mm holes; exact bolt count and center coordinates unselected.
factory_hole_bolt_pattern.qualification: Bolts listed for wood fixing, but displayed characteristic table uses nailed flange A and M10 flange B in CLT/rigid-substrate arrangement, not this both-flanges-bolted wood-to-wood joint.

alternatives.orientation: Keep manufacturer's flange A/B distinction in a 90-degree wood-to-wood corner. Member assignment, grain direction and bolt axes require station-specific layout.

force_moment_coverage.published: Page describes F1 central-axis tension, F2/F3 lateral shear, F4/F5 transverse force with eccentricity. It says only two-angle F1-F3 values appear on sheet and directs inquiry for F4/F5.
force_moment_coverage.this_bolted_joint: No applicable published resistance adopted for separation, F1-F5, or combined actions.
force_moment_coverage.moment_stiffness: Independent couple, prying, moment, stiffness and slip unknown.

alternatives.paired_use: Manufacturer two-angle discussion does not qualify an unverified wood-to-wood M10-bolted pair. Single-angle reductions depend on rotation restraint/eccentricity; pair fit and sharing unknown.
alternatives.fit: Nominal broad-face envelope only. Hole centers, edge distances, skew, opposing stacks, panel/kicker axes, retained frame bolts, tool access, and withdrawal untested at 24 stations.
alternatives.fabrication_implications: Factory-hole representative geometry mock-up may use a complete M10-class bolt/washer/nut stack. New timber bores need a later station layout; no purchase or drilling schedule or nail/screw-capacity transfer.
unresolved_fields: Applicable wood-to-wood bolt installation and resistance for both flanges
Factory hole centers and selected bolt pattern
Timber grain, edge/end distance, splitting, bearing, net section
Flange/bolt/prying, force combination, moment, stiffness and slip
Paired use, fit, access and disassembly by station

decision: No option replaces the 144 SDS attachments or qualifies all 24 stations. ML24Z through-bolts remain unresolved; HL33/HL35 fail the preserved 2x6 receiver; AB90 is a representative geometry prototype only. Do not buy, drill, enlarge members, add custom steel, or transfer published loads from this matrix.
